update_weights_from_disk: update model weights in-place from disk with optional cache flush
update_weights_from_tensor: update model weights from in-memory tensors with optional draft model support and cache flush
update_weights_from_distributed: update model weights across distributed GPUs with optional cache flush
release_memory_occupation: release GPU memory by offloading KV cache, weights, or CUDA graphs when the server is idle
resume_memory_occupation: resume previously released GPU memory for KV cache, weights, or CUDA graphs
